short-city-tour.title: Short City Tour
short-city-tour.summary: Main city highlights in four hours — ideal when time is tight.
short-city-tour.description: Our Short City Tour covers Addis Ababa’s main highlights at a comfortable pace. Perfect for first-time visitors with limited time: Meskel Square orientation, a signature landmark stop, a traditional coffee ceremony, and a gemstone store visit before hotel return.
highlights: National Museum or Holy Trinity Cathedral

itinerary.text: Hotel pickup and Meskel Square city orientation.
National Museum of Ethiopia or Holy Trinity Cathedral.
Traditional coffee ceremony and gemstone store visit.

faqs.q: Can we choose which landmark to visit?
faqs.a: Yes — tell us your priority (museum or cathedral) and we shape the short route.

faqs.q: Is this good for a busy schedule?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Four focused hours cover the main highlights without rushing the whole city.

half-day-city-tour.title: Half-Day City Tour
half-day-city-tour.summary: History, culture, and landmarks across a balanced six-hour Addis itinerary.
half-day-city-tour.description: The Half-Day City Tour goes deeper into Addis Ababa’s history, culture, and landmarks. Expect guided stops at the National Museum of Ethiopia, Holy Trinity Cathedral, Unity Park or Merkato, plus Meskel Square context and time for coffee or a gemstone store visit.

itinerary.text: Pickup, Meskel Square orientation, then National Museum of Ethiopia.
Holy Trinity Cathedral and guided historical context.
Unity Park or Merkato, plus coffee ceremony or gemstone store.

faqs.q: Unity Park or Merkato — which should we pick?
faqs.a: Unity Park suits history and gardens; Merkato suits markets and city energy. We’ll recommend based on your interests.
About six hours, with flexible pacing for photos and rest stops.

full-day-city-tour.title: Full-Day City Tour
full-day-city-tour.summary: A comprehensive Addis Ababa experience — viewpoints, culture, markets, and local flavor.
full-day-city-tour.description: See the best of Addis Ababa in one day with Mesfin Shumet Tour and Travel. This comprehensive city experience balances Mount Entoto viewpoints, the National Museum, Holy Trinity Cathedral, Unity Park, Merkato, Meskel Square, a traditional coffee ceremony, and a gemstone store stop.

itinerary.text: Mount Entoto viewpoint and city panorama.
National Museum of Ethiopia, Holy Trinity Cathedral, and lunch stop.
Unity Park or Merkato, Meskel Square, coffee ceremony, and gemstone store.

faqs.a: Yes — share priorities and we customize the full-day route.
Lunch is not included; we recommend a local restaurant and help with timing.

airport-layover-tour.title: Airport Layover Tour
airport-layover-tour.summary: Airport pickup, city sightseeing, and return — make the most of your layover in Addis.
airport-layover-tour.description: Turn a layover into a real Addis Ababa experience. We meet you at Bole Airport, guide a timed city sightseeing route (landmarks, museum or cathedral, coffee ceremony, gemstone store), and return you to the airport with buffer time for your next flight.
highlights: City sightseeing timed to your layover

itinerary.text: Meet at Bole Airport and confirm remaining layover time.
Meskel Square, National Museum or Holy Trinity, and city highlights.
Coffee ceremony and optional gemstone store stop.
Airport drop-off with comfortable buffer before departure.

faqs.q: How long does my layover need to be?
faqs.a: Ideally 8+ hours total airport-to-airport. We tailor a 6–8 hour tour once we know your arrival and departure times.
Yes — we can store bags in the vehicle or advise on airport left-luggage options.
